caption: The drawing displays two objects on a beige background. On the left is a single moccasin with elaborately decorated uppers, displaying a floral pattern rendered in various colors, including red, yellow, blue, green, and white. The outlines and borders of the moccasin are distinctly marked with darker lines, and the sole is shaded in light tan and beige. On the right side of the image is a rectangular breechcloth or cloth, predominantly black, with one vertical edge featuring multicolored stripes and zigzag patterns in shades of yellow, blue, green, purple, and pink. Each object has small handwritten notes nearby that identify them, mentioning “EASTERN WOODLAND HALL CASE 5W PENOBSCOT TRIBE,” along with additional details and a signature dated November 4th, 1935 by Mary E. Boone. The objects appear evenly spaced against the plain background, and the drawing details both items using colored pencil or crayon, emphasizing their textures and patterns.
title: Moccasin
